Fascinating highlights from Pew on how America has changed in last 50 years:

1. Percentage of 65+ people has doubled
2. Foreign born population has tripled
3. Economic gaps have widened
4. Adults with bach degree tripled
5. 63% live in the West or South (vs. 48% in 1970)

A United Nations official says she found “clear and convincing” information that hostages have been raped and sexually abused in Gaza and “reasonable grounds” to believe sexual violence, including rape and gang rape, occurred during the Oct. 7 terrorist attack led by Hamas.
